sloka: दिष्ट्या च कुशली रामो धर्मात्मा सत्यसङ्गरः ।लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजाः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः ।। ५.३६.१२।।।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā ca kuśalī rāmo dharmātmā satyasaṅgaraḥ ।lakṣmaṇaśca mahātejāḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ।। 5.36.12।।।।

translations.english: "To my luck, righteous Rama who abides in truth and glorious Lakshmana who enhances the joy of Sumitra are keeping well.
